newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan lower house OKs Pension Reform bill.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan lower house OKs Pension Reform bill.

text.p: The lower chamber of Venezuela's Congress approved late Wednesday the first reading of the Social Security reform bill, local papers reported.

The bill, which complements the Labor Reform bill due to be signed into law by President Rafael Caldera later Thursday, now goes to a special commission for further discussion before returning to the lower chamber for a second reading.
The bill, which puts in place regulations governing a fully funded pension system as well as health and unemployment insurance, will then pass to the Senate.
